title: RHC Entity V2 Knowledge (EV2-14 owner-local knowledge)
description: Owner-local knowledge record (EV2-14 evolution of the EV2-03 foundation). A record belongs to exactly one owning entity and records whether that entity's knowledge is tracked at all (known/unknown/not_applicable). When known, it carries a non-empty list of entries; every entry holds exactly one content mode: a reusable fact reference (`fact_id` into knowledge/facts.json, whose own visibility is inherited from the referenced fact at read time and never copied into the knower record; knower-local annotations such as topic/note/source are internal metadata and are not part of a player-facing fact projection) or a concise local scalar assertion (`value`, which carries its own `visibility` because the assertion itself is the underlying information). Each entry declares an epistemic_status of confirmed/belief/suspicion for this knower only; belief/suspicion never promotes into world truth and the existence of a reusable fact never grants knowledge. Entry values remain plain scalars so no structured directive can be stored as data, and no per-entry knowledge identity, runtime mutation, propagation or secrets machinery is modelled here.

topic.description: Knower-local routing/authoring label. For fact-reference entries this is internal metadata and MUST NOT be exposed in a player-facing projection merely because the referenced fact is non_meta.

note.description: Optional knower-local annotation. For fact-reference entries this is DM/internal-only by default and MUST NOT be exposed by the player-facing fact projection.

source.description: Optional knower-local provenance annotation. For fact-reference entries this is DM/internal-only by default and MUST NOT be exposed by the player-facing fact projection.
